queue.title: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Hits Highest Since 2023
queue.resumo: The US 10-year Treasury yield, a global benchmark for borrowing costs, has hit 5%. This is the highest since 2023 which could mean a hike of the price of money around the globe. Ruth Carson has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
